'''2012 US Nationals Day 2 Angelo Consoli LS Mind What You Have Learned (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Angelo Consoli]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Mind What You Have Learned (V) / Save You It Can (V)]]
* '''Username:''' GravityShadow
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
